data.title: Creek Edge
data.about:
Fantasizing about a contemporary waterfront lifestyle? Creek Edge at Dubai Creek Harbour by Emaar will turn your wildest dreams into reality as it gives you a brilliant opportunity to live on the edge of the water. Comprising of two sophisticated towers of 20 and 40 floors rising above Creek Island’s waterfront promenade, this lavish residential destination offers a collection of beautifully furnished 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom apartments. What’s more, it offers a treasure trove of exclusive amenities that will make you indulge in your favourite pleasures in life.

Savour the beauty of your existence in Dubai’s most panoramic community. Live life to the fullest at Creek Edge.

Exquisite Lifestyle at the Heart of Nature
Tranquil, luxurious, beautiful—these are the three of the best words to describe waterfront living in one of the most beautiful landmarks in the metropolis. Home to scenic vies, grandiose landscapes, lush greenery, and lively parks, Creek Edge is where the heart of nature beats at its finest.

Get Overwhelmed with World-class Amenities
Every day is an adventure at Creek Edge at Dubai Creek Harbour by Emaar, as a world of endless possibilities await right at your doorstep. Whether you love fitness activities, enjoy pampering yourself, or are fond of meditation and socialization, there is a special amenity to cater to your needs and wants here.
